title: TransitionRules
description: The relationship-state transition rule set (ADR-0012): per transition, the facts it rests on, which are required for CONFIRMED, the CANDIDATE gate and the contradictions (decisive ones REJECT it). Data, not code: thresholds, vocabularies and the buying-group predicate are named configuration, and every condition is evaluable deterministically from AccountState fields, claims, the buying group and signals (no LLM). The instance is contracts/transitions/rules.v1.json.

evaluation.description: How the detector applies the rules, in order; normative for the detector.

confidence.description: StateTransition.confidence = satisfied required facts / required facts, rounded to 3 places.

anchors.description: Meaning of each 'since' value. A rule that uses one must not list 'unknown' in from_states (there is no anchor).

claim_standings.description: Standings a claim must have to count as evidence for a claim.* condition: first-party only, so enrichment (third_party) never earns a state.

claim_statuses.description: Claim statuses that count as evidence for a claim.* condition: active and superseded (a superseded claim is an earlier statement the customer made); outranked, expired and rejected claims never count.

buying_group_member_statuses.description: The buying-group predicate: 'buying_group.<role>' matches members holding that role whose status is one of these.

vocabularies.description: Value lists for AccountState fields whose vocabulary is not an enum in account_state.v1.json (motion is free text there; its canonical values are the opportunities.motion CHECK).

claim_scope.description: deal: for each open deal the rule reads that deal's OpportunityState fields, claims and signals (and those of no deal); account: it reads every claim and signal. Facts hold when they hold in any open deal (ADR-0016).

candidate.description: CANDIDATE gate: at least one requires_any fact holds AND at least min_satisfied.threshold of the min_satisfied.of facts hold (change evidence only, never static state).

confirmed.description: CONFIRMED gate: every requires_all fact holds (exactly the facts with required=true) and no decisive contradiction holds.

after_candidate.description: Confirm only when this rule's own CANDIDATE was recorded by an earlier evaluation.

contradictions.description: Contradicting evidence, recorded whenever it holds; a decisive one (rejects=true) moves an open transition of this rule to REJECTED.

factDef.description: A fact holds when any one of its condition groups holds; a group holds when all of its conditions hold.

har97.description: The HAR-97 wording this fact implements.

condition.description: path: 'state.<field>' (AccountState field value), 'state.<field>.standing' (its winning claim's standing), 'claim.<field_path>' (claims on that field_path whose standing is in claim_standings), 'buying_group.<role>' (members with that role and a status in buying_group_member_statuses, optionally filtered by 'where'), 'diff.<signal_type>' (signals of that type; 'exists' = open per ADR-0011). Ops: eq/neq/in/known/is_unknown on values; age_days_gte on a timestamp-valued field; has_item = a list item of kind value that is open, overdue or has no status; fired_within_days = a signal created within the threshold window; asserted_within_days = a claim on that field_path asserted (occurred_at) within the window, or for a state path the field is known and its as_of is within the window. 'since' further requires the evidence (signal created_at, claim occurred_at, field as_of) to be STRICTLY after the anchor. 'about' compares the claim's or signal's subject_person_id with the current champion. A key an op does not use is rejected, so nothing in a rule is silently ignored.

stance.description: Which claims a claim.* condition selects: stated (the default) or withdrawn. A withdrawn claim never counts as stated evidence.

value.description: Literal for eq/neq/has_item (string) or in (array of strings); never a number (numbers are thresholds). Validated against the path's vocabulary.

where.description: Buying-group paths only: further member filter, e.g. {"tenure": "interim"}.

about.description: Claim and signal paths only: the evidence's subject_person_id is (champion) or is not (not_champion) the current champion.

allOf.description: 'about' qualifies evidence that names a person: claims, and signals that fired.
'since' needs evidence with a time: not on absence, unknown-ness or age checks.
